title: Vaporesso Xros Series Corex 3.0 Version Replacement 2ml Pods - 4 Pods
description: These genuine Vaporesso XROS Series COREX 3.0 Mesh Pods are designed to deliver pin-sharp flavour and stable, consistent performance across the XROS family, including the XROS Pro 2. Each 2ml pod features COREX 3.0 mesh (Hive Mesh) and Vaporesso’s proven leak-reducing SSS structure, with a simple top-fill port under the removable mouthpiece. Choose a resistance to match your preferred draw and e-liquid: • 0.4ohm: warm, airier draw for loose DTL/RDL best with 70/30 High-VG e-liquids. • 0.6ohm: versatile MTL to light RDL; ideal with 50/50 or nicotine salts. • 0.8ohm: balanced MTL; 50/50 or nicotine salts. • 1.0ohm: tight MTL; 50/50 and higher strengths. • 1.2ohm: extra-tight MTL; nicotine salts/high-strength 50/50.Four pods per pack. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
